Propagate

PROP-uh-gayt -- stress on the first syllable, PROP. · verb

Hear It

What It Means

To propagate spread and promote widely.

Volunteers propagate the endangered wildflowers in greenhouses before replanting them across the prairie.

Worked Example

One student posts the dance challenge on Monday; by Friday, kids in forty countries have filmed their own versions and passed it along to their followers.

The challenge propagated across the globe -- it spread widely as each person passed it to the next. To propagate is to spread and promote something, from plants grown from cuttings to ideas that multiply from person to person.

How Propagate Sits Among Its Neighbors

Antonyms

How Strong Is It? — spread → propagate → disseminate

spread vs. propagate

spread vs. propagate: Spread is the plain, everyday word and weaker than propagate -- butter spreads on toast, but ideas and plants are propagated: spread deliberately and multiplied as they go.

disseminate vs. propagate

disseminate vs. propagate: Disseminate is even more systematic than propagate: to propagate an idea is to help it spread and take root, while to disseminate it is to broadcast it methodically, scattering it like seed to every corner of an audience.

Build the Word

The pieces

prefix — pro-

prefix — pro-: forth, forward (Latin)

root — pag-/pang-

root — pag-/pang-: to fasten, to fix (Latin pangere)

suffix — -ate

suffix — -ate: to make, to act (Latin -atus)

Put it together

Put it together: Propagate comes from Latin propagare, a gardener's word for multiplying plants by fastening down shoots so they take root -- built from pro- ('forth') and pangere ('to fasten'). To propagate anything -- plants, ideas, news -- is to fix it in new ground again and again so that it spreads.

Use the root in a new word: pact

Use the root in a new word: pact: The two rival schools made a pact to share the athletic fields on alternating weekends.

Root Check

Word Choice

Propagate works in two worlds: gardeners propagate plants from seeds and cuttings, and people propagate ideas, beliefs, and rumors. In the idea sense it is neutral-to-formal and often implies deliberate promotion -- propaganda is its close cousin -- so choose it when something is being actively spread, not just drifting.
